content: AccessCount . value describes an intrinsic property The AccessCount . value s in an AccessCountSet are statements about the im- plementation of single ExecutableEntity s with respect to RTE/SchM API usage when the code is executed. Those values are independent from the later integration of the respective AbstractAccessPoint of a specific ExecutableEntity s.
